notes.title: Critical Choices: Unveiling the Last Big Update - Alignment!
notes.content:
Dear Gamers,

Exciting news awaits on the horizon of SameShadow: Fernando's Journey! Before the Steam Next Fest, we're thrilled to introduce the final significant update to our Skill Tree - the much-anticipated [b]"Alignment" [/b]system. This game-changing addition offers eight unique passive skills, each with both positive and negative buffs, reshaping your entire gameplay experience. Get ready to make strategic decisions and tailor your journey with these Alignments, each costing 3 awaken points:

[u][b]Alignment List:[/b][/u]

[b]-Warmonger:[/b] Deal and take 50% more Melee and Bullet damage.
[b]-Pacifism:[/b] Deal and take 50% less Melee and Bullet damage.
[b]-Ragdoll God:[/b] Deal 200% more Ragdoll damage and become Unlucky.
[b]-Luck Goddess: [/b]Get 50% more Luck. Deal no Ragdoll damage and take more Ragdoll damage.
[b]-Energy Purity:[/b] Increase your base Energy by 50% and Decrease your base Health by 60%.
[b]-Health Purity:[/b] Increase your base Health by 50% and Decrease your base Energy by 60%.
[b]-Self Destruct:[/b] Deal and take 33% more Explosive damage, Rage Radius Increased by 25% and drastically hinder your Teleportation Range.
[b]-Last Stand:[/b] Deal and take 33% less Explosive damage, Rage Radius Increased by 25% and Drastically hinder your Teleportation Range
[b]Spirit Over Might: [/b]Increase your Energy by 50% and Decrease your Bullet Damage by 50%
[b]Vigor Over Power: [/b]Increase your Health by 50% and Decrease your Melee Damage by 50%
[b]I Am Become Death:[/b] Increase your Energy and Health by 100%. Your Energy and Health Passive Regeneration restores 125% more. Deal 50% more Melee, Bullet, Ragdoll and Explosive Damage. -This can be Awaken after receiving "Burn it all Down" Achievement. (It will not work if not connected to Steam)


[i]Choose Wisely![/i] The downside could be a huge hindrance in the future. Prepare for a game-altering experience as you explore the diverse strategies each Alignment offers. Thank you for being part of SameShadow: Fernando's Journey, and stay tuned for more thrilling updates!

Best,
GrandPaw Games

notes.title: Available Abilities in SameShadow: Fernando's Journey!
notes.content:
[b]Dear Gamers,[/b]

[h2]Unleash an arsenal of unique abilities in SameShadow, each a key to mastering your journey[/h2]

[i]Abilities Requiring Ability Slot:[/i]

[b]Time Dominion: [/b]Slow time to unleash devastating attacks, but beware of health and energy drain.

[b]Vanish: [/b]Leach enemy health and make them vanish, yet bosses resist this skill.

[b]Particle Acceleration:[/b] Blast foes back with ragdoll damage, upgrade range, and width for tactical advantage.

[b]Bullet Rush:[/b] Hurl bullets for potent long-range strikes—ideal for diversifying your combat style.

[b]Rapid Regeneration: [/b]Sacrifice energy for rapid healing, ensuring resilience in the face of adversity.

[b]Reduced Friction:[/b] Erect an energy shield against high-velocity threats, sustain it with upgraded activation.

[b]Rage: [/b]Channel remaining energy for explosive area damage, turning the tide of close combat battles.

[b]Disarm: [/b]Disarm your enemies to turn the tide of the fight in your favor. 

[b]Blood Lust:[/b] Take your deep desires for melee combat with upgraded damage and healing for a limited time.

[b]Shattered Earth: [/b]Destroy the earth beneath you sending enemies flying back and regain some life force. 

[b]Particle Desolation:[/b] Take Particle acceleration ability to it's most ferocious level. 


[i]Abilities without Requiring Ability Slot:[/i]

[b]Tele Jump:[/b] Ascend effortlessly without fear of fall damage, granting strategic advantage.

[b]Tele Knife Throw:[/b] Precision strikes without an Ability Slot, aiming for lethal accuracy.

[b]Sword Master:[/b] Elevate your swordplay to unmatched speeds and finesse.

[b]Tele Drop: [/b]Teleport enemies skyward, inflicting impactful ragdoll damage upon their descent.

[b]Tele Missile: [/b]Teleport enemy vehicles skyward, creating your personal rods of God upon their descent.

With 115 Passive Skills and Abilities, there is a build for everyone! 

[b]Embark on a journey of mastery, wielding abilities in SameShadow's Prologue, SameShadow: Fernando's Journey![/b]

Best,
GrandPaw Games
